quest.title: Build a jar rainforest together
quest.why_this: Llamie liked two terrarium builds and the handmade ramen video, and all three are about patient, layered making. This turns that watching into a small build with real moss and soil.
materials: Clear glass jar with a lid
Moss from the garden or a plant shop
steps: Wash the jar and let it dry fully.
Add a 2 cm layer of stones at the bottom for drainage.
Add soil on top, about 4 cm deep, and shape a small hill.
Plant the small plant, then press moss around it using tweezers.
Mist lightly until the moss looks damp but not soaked.
Close the lid, set the jar in bright light without direct sun, and check it every day for a week.
quest.child_role: Llamie designs the layout and does the fine placing with the tweezers, as in the videos.
quest.parent_role: Help collect materials, ask questions while it is built, and keep an eye on the misting.
quest.conversation_prompt: What do you think will happen to the water inside the jar over the next few days?
quest.success_looks_like: A sealed jar with moss that stays green, and Llamie able to explain why the stones are at the bottom.
quest.safety_note: Wash hands after handling soil and moss.
